Ad: Kevin Trudeau tells a story about a friend who taught success seminars but kept stumbling in business.

Every time he looked at a deal he said, "I have a concern." Kevin points out that a concern is fear in words.

His advice was to swap it for "I have a question" or "there's something here we can make better."

The same situation, but now you are the one steering the conversation.

What word do you use out of habit without noticing?

#mindset #communication #kevintrudeau

Ad: Kevin Trudeau on how successful people treat disasters.

He has watched shows about the companies that built America and notices a pattern. Almost every one hit a disaster, like a factory burning down, and that was where the breakthrough idea showed up.

Kevin's own response to bad news is "maybe bad, maybe not." He believes every adversity carries the seed of a greater benefit.

What setback of yours turned out to be a gift?

#mindset #resilience #kevintrudeau

Ad: Kevin Trudeau shares a tip from a tiny old book called It Works.

It says to keep your goals and dreams to yourself. Kevin's reason: everybody wants you to do well, just not that well.

When you announce a big plan, friends, relatives and neighbors may send doubt back at you, even without meaning to.

Kevin calls that a counter intention, and says it can bombard you.

Who has truly supported your biggest goals?

#mindset #goals #kevintrudeau

Ad: Kevin Trudeau on the two sides of creating the life you want.

One side is your thinking and attitude. The other is action.

Action with a poor attitude gives poor results. Gratitude and meditation with no action gets you nowhere.

Kevin says when you combine the two, that is where the magic happens.

Which side do you lean on more, thinking or doing?

#mindset #action #kevintrudeau

Ad: Kevin Trudeau on one point he teaches about the words we use.

He says to stop telling the story of how others have wronged you. The stories all sound the same: they did this to me, they did that to me.

Kevin's challenge is to notice the one common denominator in every one of those stories, which is you. That is good news, because you can work on yourself.

What story are you ready to retire?

#mindset #growth #kevintrudeau

Ad: Kevin Trudeau explains why your recorded voice sounds strange to you.

When you speak, only part of the sound reaches your ear. Most of it travels through bone into your brain, which makes your whole head vibrate.

On a recording, all of it arrives through your ear, so it sounds different.

Kevin uses this to show that speaking your goals out loud is far more powerful than just thinking them.

What would you say out loud today about what you want?

#mindset #words #kevintrudeau
